title: City Council — 06-21-2021 CH CC Special Business Meeting Minutes-APPROVED.pdf

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Bruce moved to approve Ordinance 360 adopting additional restrictions on the use of all fireworks and to include restrictions in all areas from 1300 East and eastward of Cottonwood Heights through December 30, 2021. Council Member Bracken seconded the motion. Vote on motion: Council Member Petersen-Aye, Council Member Bracken- Aye, Council Member Bruce-Aye, Mayor Mike Peterson-Aye
MOTION: Council Member Bracken moved to adjourn. The motion was seconded by Council Member Petersen
